newsitem.title: USA: Dorchester sees 500 MCFD from Fort Riley.
newsitem.headline: Dorchester sees 500 MCFD from Fort Riley.

text.p: Dorchester Hugoton Ltd said Monday it had favorable preliminary results from tests of the Fort Riley portion of the geological formation comprising the Guymon-Hugoton Field in Oklahoma.

Dorchester said the newly drilled matter No. 2A gas well tests greater than 500,000 cubic feet per day on the Fort Riley zone, with no water and with pressure exceeding the pressure found in the nearby existing matter No. 2 gas well.
If further tests are favorable, Dorchester said it expects to complete the new well in both the Fort Riley and overlaying zones of the Guymon-Hugoton field, thus replacing the existing matter No. 2.
